capabilities: Share a note by uploading it to an AWS S3 bucket and creating a share URL
Import a shared note into the vault by opening its URL in Obsidian
Encrypt shared note content with a key embedded in the link
Delete a shared note from the S3 backend from within Obsidian
Configure a custom S3 bucket, IAM credentials, bucket policy and CORS policy
extras: The plugin is supported by advertisements. The README notes it is still in development with possible bugs. It inconsistently refers to a Pastebin backend in the frontmatter instructions while the rest describes S3.
intentEvidence: This plugin is based on the share-note plugin by @alangrainger.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand a single note to another Obsidian user via a link without publishing services or manually copying files.

relations.evidence: I used all of the code from that plugin, added just the AWS backend
This plugin complements s3-image-uploader, because it allows you to share notes with other users

requires.name: AWS account with an existing S3 bucket and an IAM user with write access

summary: Shares a note by uploading encrypted Markdown to your own AWS S3 bucket and generating a URL that imports it into another user's vault.
